mapper.select: select TABLE_NAME tableName from user_tables where table_name = #{tableName}
mapper.update: create table ${newTableName} as select * from CHB_INFO_REPORT where 1=0
mapper.insert: insert into ${newTableName} select * from CHB_INFO_REPORT rep where rep.REPORT_NO in ( select distinct REPORT_NO from CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS left join CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB on CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SEQNO = CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.SUMIT_SEQ where CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') and REPORT_NO is not null )
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_INFO_REPORT rep where rep.REPORT_NO in ( select distinct REPORT_NO from CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS left join CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB on CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SEQNO = CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.SUMIT_SEQ where CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') and REPORT_NO is not null )
mapper.update: create table ${newTableName} as select CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.* from CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS where 1=0
mapper.insert: insert into ${newTableName} select CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.* from CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS left join CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB on CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SEQNO = CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.SUMIT_SEQ where CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS where CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SEQNO in( select SUMIT_SEQ from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB where HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') )
mapper.update: create table ${newTableName} as select * from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO where 1=0
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO info where info.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.update: create table ${newTableName} as select * from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB sub where 1=0
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB sub where sub.HOLD_DATE = to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.select: select count(1) from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB where SEND_STATUS = '01' and HOLD_DATE < to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
select distinct hold_date from CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB where SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and HOLD_DATE < to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') order by HOLD_DATE desc
mapper.update: insert into ${newTableName} select CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.* from CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS left join CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB on CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SEQNO = CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.SUMIT_SEQ where CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.HOLD_DATE >= to_date(#{dataBackupDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
CREATE TABLE ${newTableName} AS SELECT * FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK sub where 1=0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT T.INDEX_NAME FROM USER_IND_COLUMNS T,USER_INDEXES I WHERE T.INDEX_NAME = I.INDEX_NAME AND T.TABLE_NAME = I.TABLE_NAME AND T.TABLE_NAME = #{tableName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT /*+ append */ INTO ${newTableName} SELECT /*+ parallel(CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS,8) */ CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.* FROM CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB ON CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SEQNO = CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.SUMIT_SEQ WHERE CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.HOLD_DATE BETWEEN to_date(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND to_date(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SUBMIT_TYPE = '16'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS WHERE CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SEQNO IN( SELECT SUMIT_SEQ FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB WHERE CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB.HOLD_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS.SUBMIT_TYPE = '16' )
mapper.select: SELECT PARTITION_NAME FROM USER_TAB_PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_NAME = #{tableName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PARTITION_POSITION!=1
SELECT 1 FROM ${tableName} partition (${patitionName}) WHERE HOLD_DATE BETWEEN to_date(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND to_date(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
mapper.insert: INSERT /*+ append */ INTO ${newTableName} SELECT /*+ parallel(T,8) */ T.* FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_CHECK T WHERE T.HOLD_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T.OPERATE_STATUS ='02'
